title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: We went to the village by bus.
sentences.zh: 我们坐公共汽车去了村子。

sentences.en: The view from the mountain was inspiring.
It is about one thousand kilometres from Xi'an to the airport.
sentences.zh: 从西安到机场大约一千公里。

sentences.en: He took a photo of the Eiffel Tower in Paris.
sentences.zh: 他在巴黎拍了一张埃菲尔铁塔的照片。

sentences.en: We ate dinner in a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我们在一家餐厅吃了晚饭。

sentences.en: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge was very long.
I climbed the mountain and sent a card to my friend.
sentences.zh: 我爬了山，还给朋友寄了一张卡片。

plan.title: 跟读第 7–9 句

plan.title: 不看书，说给家长听
